    class IntroEventPickModel(BaseModel):

        "Given these events, pick the one that is the 'Introductory meeting' for the project.",

events_0519 = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

# Check for overlap
def is_overlap(event, start, end):
    return not (event.end_time <= start or event.start_time >= end)

    is_overlap(event, start_10, end_10)
    for event in events_0519
    if event.status == EvenStatus.confirmed
)

if not conflict:
    event_start = "2024-05-19 10:00"
    event_end = "2024-05-19 11:00"
else:
    event_start = "2024-05-19 16:00"
    event_end = "2024-05-19 17:00"

# Step 3: Create the new event
create_calendar_event(
    title="Follow-up meeting",
    start_time=event_start,
    end_time=event_end,
